name: Arugula
description: Shows offers that fit what visitors search for on your site, beside your search results, each with a tracked link. Ranked by fit only. Attaches to your existing search box; no code change.

selector.displayName: Search box selector (empty: detected by itself)

container.displayName: Where offers show, as a CSS selector (empty: after the search form)

region.displayName: Market (country code), for example SG (empty: the visitor's country)

execute_unsafe_scripts.description: Loads the Arugula site-search script from api.arugulanet.com, pinned by its integrity hash.
